data.title: A Greek classic
data.description: Greek composer, vocalist, lyricist and ensemble leader Stella Papalamprou is riding high in the World Music charts with her latest release Protanixin, a six-track self-released album that explores the music of the Pontic region in Greek Macedonia.

data.title: Fatima tones it down
data.description: Opera in Thai is a challenging prospect. In addition to handling the aspects of choosing a librettist, creating an effective operatic structure and writing for that most finicky of instruments, the human voice, a composer has to deal with the Thai language.

data.title: Inheriting the future of horror
data.description: Around the world, horror is having a major cinematic moment. From low-budget internet phenomena turned studio hits like The Backrooms (2026) to high-concept thrillers like Obsession (2025), chilling subversions of the genre are proving that audiences will still flock to cinemas, if given a reason to step into the dark.

data.title: First look at LV The Place Bangkok’s new concept
data.description: Louis Vuitton unveils the first look at LV The Place Bangkok in its new concept, through an inspiring new chapter of the Art of Travel.

data.title: Hello Kitty firm apologises, scraps TV tie-up after China anger
data.description: BEIJING - Sanrio, the Japanese company that owns the popular Hello Kitty character, apologised on Thursday over its tie-up with a TV spy drama criticised as anti-China, cancelling a merchandise collaboration with the show.

data.description: LOS ANGELES — Pierce Brosnan and Helen Mirren have found they quite enjoy mob life, as they embody the dangerous and volatile criminal boss couple Conrad and Maeve Harrigan in " MobLand ."

data.title: Nene Royal to perform at  Happitat's Spooktacular Festival
data.description: Happitat, a lifestyle and retail destination on Bang Na-Trat Road, invites everyone to step into a mysterious Halloween world of magic and wonder during its Spooktacular Festival, which is running until Sunday.

data.title: Movies, music & more at Chula Klangplaeng 2026
data.description: An evening of outdoor cinema, live music, creative workshops and local stories awaits at Chula Klangplaeng 2026, returning for its third edition on Nov 6 at Chula 100th Anniversary Park.

data.title: The sound of art
data.description: After retiring from his position as dean of the Faculty of Law at Chulalongkorn University, Prof Nantawat Boramanand has taken on a new mission -- to fund cochlear implant surgeries for children with hearing loss through the Foundation for the Deaf under the Royal Patronage of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit, The Queen Mother.

data.title: Dutch broadcaster pulls out of Eurovision over Israel 'sensitivities'
data.description: THE HAGUE - The Netherlands will not participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest, its public broadcaster NPO said on Tuesday, citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation.

data.title: US singer Chris Brown avoids jail over London nightclub brawl
data.description: LONDON - American singer Chris Brown avoided jail when sentenced by a UK court on Monday after pleading guilty to a public order offence during a 2023 brawl at a London nightclub.

data.title: Sala Sudasiri Sobha hosts Duo Baraldi from Italy
data.description: OLive Music presents "Roots And Migrations" by Duo Baraldi from Italy at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.

data.title: Oktoberfest comes to  One Bangkok Park
data.description: One Bangkok invites everyone to join "One Oktoberfest", a grand celebration inspired by Germany's iconic cultural festival at One Bangkok Park, Rama IV Road, from tomorrow to Sunday, starting from 4pm on weekdays and 2pm on weekends.

data.title: Malaysia's Padu wraps World Film Series
data.description: The 2026 Contemporary World Film Series will conclude with a screening of Padu from Malaysia, at TK Park, 8th floor of CentralWorld, Ratchadamri Road, on Saturday at 4pm.

data.title: Water, ways of life  converge at 'Confluent'
data.description: Miranda Housden explores water in Thai and Western mythologies for her solo exhibition at Bangkok University Gallery, running until Nov 25.

data.title: Passionin motion
data.description: Nostalgia poured thick when Hong Kong's Jumbo Floating Restaurant, an iconic spot that was forced to close due to Covid-19 in 2020 after four decades of operation, appeared on the screen at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre's Studio Theatre in Tsim Sha Tsui. Audiences soon found themselves sailing through a tide of motifs -- neon-lit streets, flats, colonial buildings, churches, vessels and food -- much like the Star Ferry crossing Victoria Harbour, just a stone's throw away. The piano conjured a pleasant daydream, at least until something strange happened.

data.title: ‘Call of Duty’ seeks to win back fans with warfare spectacle
data.description: The latest instalment in the “Call of Duty” video game franchise, arriving on Friday, brings back the high-adrenaline action that fuelled its success in an effort to revitalise a series that has been losing momentum.

data.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
data.description: Versatile actor Tom ⁠Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits, ​including the sci-fi classic Alien , the war comedy M*A*S*H , and the action drama Top Gun, has died at the age of 93.
